Theravada Portal

Theravāda is a major branch of Buddhism having the the Pali canon (
tipitaka
) as their canonical literature, which includes the 
vinaya-pitaka
 (monastic rules), the 
sutta-pitaka
 (Buddhist sermons) and the 
abhidhamma-pitaka
 (philosophy and psychology).
